checks.name: game_players_agent_name_length_check
checks.expression: agent_name is null or char_length(agent_name) between 1 and 40
checks.definition: check (agent_name is null or char_length(agent_name) between 1 and 40)

checks.name: games_active_black_seat_check
checks.expression: status not in ('active', 'finished') or black_seat is not null
checks.definition: check (status not in ('active', 'finished') or black_seat is not null)

checks.name: games_clock_ms_check
checks.expression: clock_ms_1 between 0 and 600000 and clock_ms_2 between 0 and 600000
checks.definition: check (clock_ms_1 between 0 and 600000 and clock_ms_2 between 0 and 600000)

checks.name: games_draw_no_winner_check
checks.expression: end_reason is distinct from 'draw' or winner_seat is null
checks.definition: check (end_reason is distinct from 'draw' or winner_seat is null)

checks.name: games_finished_at_check
checks.expression: status <> 'finished' or finished_at is not null
checks.definition: check (status <> 'finished' or finished_at is not null)

checks.name: games_rematch_pending_check
checks.expression: rematch_state is distinct from 'pending' or (rematch_offered_by_seat is not null and rematch_expires_at is not null)
checks.definition: check (rematch_state is distinct from 'pending' or (rematch_offered_by_seat is not null and rematch_expires_at is not null))

checks.name: games_started_at_check
checks.expression: status not in ('active', 'finished') or started_at is not null
checks.definition: check (status not in ('active', 'finished') or started_at is not null)

checks.name: games_winner_required_check
checks.expression: end_reason is null or end_reason = 'draw' or winner_seat is not null
checks.definition: check (end_reason is null or end_reason = 'draw' or winner_seat is not null)
